claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down at approximately 5:07 p.m. PDT.
5:07 p.m. PDT for the Artemis II mission splashdown is 8:07 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II crew will be recovered by the U.S. Navy and the USS John P. Murtha.
Live coverage of the Artemis II mission is available on NASA's YouTube channel.
Live coverage of the Artemis II mission is available on Netflix.
Live coverage of the Artemis II mission is available on NASA+.
The Artemis II crew is expected to experience a sonic boom around 5:00-5:15 p.m. PDT.
According to the Astronomy Magazine guide, coverage of the reentry, parachute deployment, and landing begins at 6:30 p.m. EDT.
